photo_reference.availability: Uploaded to current chat by owner; NOT archived in GitHub repository; image itself cannot be presumed available to CAD agent from this JSON
photo_reference.view: Solder/trace side of one joystick daughterboard faces camera; ribbon exits upward; joystick mechanism is opposite the camera. Board held tilted by hand, so pixel distances are NOT scale-certified.
visually_observed: Five solder terminations in a horizontal row at the narrow top neck, leading to a flat ribbon cable; appears to be five-conductor ribbon (photo observed, not electrically verified).

Irregular stepped and rounded outline; narrow ribbon tab at top, broader rounded body, asymmetric right-side ear, flatter lower edge and left step. A simple circle or 32.7 x 33.5 rectangle will misrepresent shape.
Three larger open cutouts visible near upper-right edge, mid-right edge, and lower-left portion of board. Mid-right opening appears elongated/oval relative to others.
Numerous small solder pads/vias in central area are NOT additional mounting holes; do not include as mount points without confirmation.
Joystick shaft center on opposite face cannot be located precisely from this photograph.
photo_reference.confidence: Visual orientation and topology only; photo perspective, hand occlusion and missing square-on scale prevent precise contour/hole-center extraction.
photo_reference.required_for_cad: Archive original photo if possible; acquire approximately face-on, low-perspective photo with measurement reference for tracing, then spot-check key hole coordinates by caliper.
